title: A Ghost for the Safehouse
author: Coral Eriksen
blurb: Kestrel Vasquez, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
